referenceFunction.generalComment:
Originally in cubic meter. Composition: 96% CH4, 4% CO2, Density of synthetic methane: 0.72 kg/Nm3, LHV ~47.5 MJ/kg. Using the "CO2 methanation - sewage sludge - PSA - worst - BFB_FB" configuration. Source: Life cycle assessment of power-to-gas with biogas as the carbon source. Xiaojin Zhang, Julia Witte, Tilman Schildhauer and Christian Bauer. https://doi.org/10.1/C9SE00986H. Note that a 100:0 CO2 alloc. is applied: the carbon dioxide emissions from the MSWI plant are entirely allocated to the cement plant, but the carbon capture efforst fall within the synthetic natural gas producer's system boundaries. The combustion of the resulting synthetic natural gas does not lead to any carbon dioxide emissions. Source: Life cycle assessment of power-to-gas with biogas as the carbon source. Xiaojin Zhang, Julia Witte, Tilman Schildhauer and Christian Bauer. https://doi.org/10.1039/C9SE00986H
